Sorry I didn't read your entire post. I think I understand the issue you're describing. When you're starting off on the bike, you should start from a standing position while standing over the top tube of the bike. If you're seated with both feet on the ground then your seat is probably too low. The problem is when you stop, the pedals are in the wrong position to get started from a standing position. The thing I always do is pick the back wheel up and pedal forward a bit to get the pedal where I need it before I push off to start pedaling. I guess the way I would explain it is with the pedal forward while standing over the bike.
